messages.content: 將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？

function.name: thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure
function.description: Calculate gas pressure in a closed chamber due to heating Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

volume.description: The volume of the chamber in cubic meters. This is a float type value.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

initial_pressure.description: The initial pressure of the gas in Pascal. Default is standard atmospheric pressure. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？" They want to know how much gas will be produced? Actually they might mean the pressure increase? The question: "將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？" In Chinese: "How much gas will be produced when heating a 2 cubic meter sealed chamber from 25°C to 100°C?" That seems ambiguous: maybe they want the pressure change? The phrase "產生多少氣體" literally means "how much gas will be produced". But heating a sealed chamber doesn't produce gas; it increases pressure. Maybe they want the pressure increase. So we can interpret as: calculate the gas pressure in a closed chamber due to heating. Use ideal gas law: P2 = P1 * (T2/T1). T in Kelvin. So initial T=25°C=298.15K, final T=100°C=373.15K. Volume constant. So P2 = P1 * (373.15/298.15). If initial pressure is standard atmospheric pressure 101325 Pa. Then P2 = 101325 * (373.15/298.15) ≈ 101325 * 1.2525 ≈ 126,800 Pa. So pressure increase ~25.5% above atmospheric. So the pressure difference is about 25,475 Pa. So the answer: about 127 kPa. If they want the amount of gas? The moles remain same. So no new gas produced. So answer: no new gas, just pressure increase. Provide calculation. Use function.
